summary: Frontend-only regression for SMARTCLOUT restoration of dither section dividers + new 3-column About layout with glassmorphism stat cards + rack scatter pre-interaction. ALL 12 acceptance items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css is now 3665+ lines — approaching size limits; consider splitting into per-section stylesheets (sc-dither, sc-statcard, sc-partners2, sc-rack, sc-blueprint) that import into App.css.

SectionDivider renders 4096 span nodes per divider (COLS=512 × ROWS=8) × 4 dark↔light transitions = 16,384 DOM nodes just for dividers. Runtime is fine, but consider a canvas or SVG <pattern> approach if additional dividers are added.

PartnersV2Section.jsx pool useMemo includes duplicates (e.g. DELL appears in servers, storage, network) — scatter shows DELL twice in some ticks (seen in test: two 'DELL' entries). If uniqueness by name is desired, dedupe on p.name instead of `${cat.id}:${p}`. Otherwise ignore.
AboutSection.jsx openStat default is hardcoded to 'projects' string literal instead of referencing t.about.stat_cards[1].id or a constant — brittle if translation IDs change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four dark↔light dividers correctly render as .sc-dither mosaics (contrast>=100 branch), 4096 cells each, height~22.5px on desktop 1440 — matches the '3/4 shorter' requirement. About uses lg:grid-cols-12 with lg:col-span-8 narrative + lg:col-span-4 stat cards. Default open stat is 'projects' (aria-expanded=true). Stat card values: 20+/350+/130+. Language toggle testid = 'lang-toggle' (button text 'PL / EN'). PartnersV2 scatter: pool includes duplicates by category (DELL appears in servers+storage+network) so scatter can occasionally show the same name twice — considered acceptable per spec. After 2.6s interval, scatter refreshes (verified different names at t=0 and t=3.2s). Post-interaction scatter never returns (hasInteracted state is one-way). Contact section: 'lang-toggle', 'ai-restart', 'ai-send-turn' testids present.

about.chevron rotates via is-open class: PASS (screenshot shows chevron pointing up for open projects card)

partners_rack_pre_interaction.scatter refresh @2.6s: PASS (t=0 and t=3.2s show different names)
